commands.name: add
commands.description: Used by contributors to add information about their  changes by creating changeset files.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Sets up the .changeset folder and generates a default  config file. You should run this command once when you are setting up  changesets.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: This publishes changes to specified nuget repository.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Provides information about the changesets that currently  exist. If there are no changesets present, it exits with an error status code.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Takes existing changeset files and updates versions and  dependencies of packages, as well as writing changelogs.
